0: Welcome to Hollowmere! Seeds are in the back.
New farmers always buy too few parsnips. Just saying.
3: You're becoming a regular! I like that.
The Wildlings around your farm seem happier lately.
6: I saved the freshest seeds for you this morning.
My grandmother ran this store. She'd have liked you.
9: You feel like family now. Don't tell anyone I gave you a discount.
Hollowmere is livelier since you came.

season.spring: Spring is the best season for parsnips. Trust me.
season.summer: Melons sell for a fortune in summer!
season.fall: Pumpkins fly off the shelves in fall.
season.winter: Winter crops are tricky, but Frost Wildlings help.

2: Mira is counting seed packets.
Mira: Oh! You startled me. Inventory day...
Mira: Here, take these. A thank-you for being such a good customer.
5: Mira shows you an old photo of the store.
Mira: My grandmother founded this place with one bag of seeds.
Mira: She always said a valley grows as much as its people do.
8: Mira hands you a hand-written recipe card.
Mira: Grandma's berry tart. I've never shared it with anyone.
Mira: I think she'd want you to have it.

0: Need something built? Bring wood and coin.
That old farm of yours has good bones.
3: Your fences are holding up nicely.
A Stone Wildling clears land faster than any shovel.
6: I carved this bench myself. Took three weeks.
You've got a builder's eye, you know.
9: If you ever want to learn woodworking, my door's open.
Best client I've ever had. And friend.

season.spring: Spring rain warps the lumber. Keep it dry!
season.summer: Hot days are good for drying wood.
season.fall: Fall is building season. Everyone wants a barn.
season.winter: I fix tools in winter. Quiet work.

2: Bram is struggling with a heavy beam.
Bram: Mind lending a hand? ... Thanks. You're stronger than you look.
Bram: Take some wood. I cut too much anyway.
5: Bram shows you a tiny wooden Wildling figurine.
Bram: I carve one for every kid born in town.
Bram: Maybe I'll carve one for you someday.
8: Bram hands you a polished wooden key.
Bram: Spare key to my workshop. Use any tools you like.
Bram: And I'll give you a discount on your next building.

0: Bring ore, get bars. Bring bars, get better tools.
Hmph. Another farmer.
3: Your pickaxe swings are getting cleaner.
Ember Wildlings make the best forge companions.
6: I forged my first sword at age nine. Terrible sword.
You're alright, farmer.
9: You're the only one who listens to my metal stories.
I'd forge anything for you. Within reason.

season.spring: Spring means broken hoes. Lots of them.
season.summer: The forge in summer is miserable. I love it.
season.fall: Fall ore from Cinder Ridge is the finest.
season.winter: Nothing beats a warm forge in winter.

2: Greta is hammering a glowing bar.
Greta: Watch. See how it rings? Means it's pure.
Greta: Take some ore. Practice.
5: Greta shows you an old, notched hammer.
Greta: My mentor's hammer. She taught me patience.
Greta: Metal doesn't care about your mood. Neither do Wildlings, if you rush them.
8: Greta hands you a gleaming gold bar.
Greta: Don't make it weird. Just... thanks for visiting.

0: Every Wildling you befriend helps my research. Keep your Wildling-dex updated!
Wildlings love food from the farm. Use it when befriending.
3: Did you know Wildlings level up from farm work too?
Breeding in the Den can pass on great genes.
6: Your Wildlings are remarkably healthy. You treat them well.
I suspect there are Wildlings that only appear in certain seasons...
9: You've done more for Wildling science than anyone.
Without you, the Grove Shrines would still be dark.

season.spring: Spring brings many Leaf Wildlings out.
season.summer: Watch for Spark Wildlings during storms.
season.fall: Shade Wildlings get bolder in fall.
season.winter: Frost Wildlings come down from the mountains in winter.

2: Fern is studying a sleeping Mossbun.
Fern: Shh... Wildlings dream, you know. Look at its ears twitch.
Fern: Here, take these charms for your research.
5: Fern shows you an ancient carving of eight creatures.
Fern: The Grove Guardians. Legend says they kept this valley in balance.
Fern: Restoring the shrines may wake them...
8: Fern gives you a shimmering charm.
Fern: This charm makes Starry Wildlings appear more often.
Fern: I can't think of anyone better to have it.

0: Welcome to the Sleepy Sprout! Take a seat anywhere.
Our special today is whatever's fresh from your farm.
3: Your veggies make the best stew. Seriously.
I named the cafe after a Sproutle that slept on my doorstep.
6: I saved you a slice of honey cake.
Cooking for you is my favorite part of the day.
9: I'd cook for you every day if you let me.
Whenever I see you walk in, the whole cafe feels warmer.

season.spring: Spring salads are my favorite.
season.summer: Cold melon soup! Trust me.
season.fall: Pumpkin season! Best season!
season.winter: Hot cocoa is free for farmers in winter.

2: Theo is experimenting with a new recipe.
Theo: Try this. Honest opinion... You like it? I'll call it Veggie Stew.
5: Theo is cleaning up after closing time.
Theo: I opened this place because my parents had a cafe in the city.
Theo: But here, people actually talk to each other. I love that.
8: Theo sets two cups of tea on the table.
Theo: I closed early tonight. For us.
Theo: ...I really like spending time with you, you know.

0: Oh, hello! Mind the paint, it's still wet.
I'm trying to paint Glimmer's glow. It's impossible!
3: Your farm would make a lovely painting.
Flowers are just paintings that grow.
6: I painted your Wildlings last night. Don't laugh!
You make the valley more colorful.
9: Every painting I make has a little bit of you in it now.
Will you sit for a portrait someday?

season.spring: The tulips are blooming! I'm painting all day.
season.summer: Sunflowers are the happiest flowers.
season.fall: The leaves give me so many new colors.
season.winter: Snow is the hardest thing to paint. It's all blue, really.

2: Lila is painting a Petalfly on a flower.
Lila: Shh! It's almost perfect... There! Oh, it flew away.
Lila: Take these seeds. Plant something pretty for me.
5: Lila shows you a gallery of tiny paintings.
Lila: These are all the Wildlings I've ever met.
Lila: I want to paint every one in the valley someday.
8: Lila hands you a small canvas.
Lila: It's you and your Wildlings, on the farm at sunset.
Lila: I hope you like it... I painted it for you.

0: You're the new farmer? Bet my Wildlings could beat yours.
Dr. Fern says you have potential. We'll see.
3: Okay, you're not bad. Rematch soon?
I'm writing a paper on Glow Wildlings. Want to help?
6: Battling you is the most fun I've had all year.
You know a lot more about Wildlings than you let on.
9: Partners in research. And... maybe more?
I don't want a rival anymore. I want you around.

season.spring: Spring is perfect for field research.
season.summer: Storm season! Spark Wildlings everywhere!
season.fall: My birthday's in fall. Just mentioning it.
season.winter: Winter is for writing papers. Ugh.

2: Juniper is scribbling in a notebook.
Juniper: Your Wildlings are healthier than mine. How?!
Juniper: Fine. I'll study YOU then.
5: Juniper shows you a rare Starry feather.
Juniper: I found it when I was a kid. It's why I became a researcher.
Juniper: I've never shown anyone before.
8: Juniper looks nervous.
Juniper: I'm not great at this... but I like being around you.
Juniper: Not as rivals. As something more.

0: So you're the new farmer. My corn's taller than yours.
Wanna battle? Loser buys lunch.
3: Your farm's coming along. Not bad, neighbor.
My grandpa taught me farming and battling. Same thing, really.
6: You ever just watch the crops grow? Me neither. Ha.
Want to plant something together sometime?
9: Best neighbor I've ever had.
Farming's better with you around.

season.spring: Spring planting! The best feeling.
season.summer: Corn! Summer is all about corn.
season.fall: Harvest Fair is mine this year.
season.winter: Winter's for resting. And battling.

2: Rowan is leaning on a fence, looking at your farm.
Rowan: You've done more with this place in weeks than anyone in years.
Rowan: Here. Some of my best corn seeds.
5: Rowan is sitting by the river.
Rowan: Grandpa used to bring me here. He passed last winter.
Rowan: ...Thanks for listening.
8: Rowan hands you a wildflower.
Rowan: Saw this and thought of you. That's... dumb, right?
Rowan: Not dumb? Okay. Good.

0: Ah, the new farmer. Your grandparent would be proud.
The Grove Shrines have been dark for many years.
3: Long ago, Wildlings and people farmed side by side.
Each shrine has a Warden. Prove yourself to them.
6: You remind me of myself, long ago. Only far better at farming.
The valley is waking up. Can you feel it?
9: The valley chose you, I think.
Come sit with an old man sometime. I have stories.

season.spring: Spring is when the valley remembers how to live.
season.summer: Summer storms once lit up the Sparkmarsh like day.
season.fall: In fall, we give thanks to the Guardians.
season.winter: Winter is long, but it always ends.

2: Barley is feeding a Gloomrat.
Barley: Don't tell anyone. He's my friend.
Barley: Every Wildling deserves kindness. Even snack thieves.
5: Barley tells you about the Great Storm.
Barley: The year the shrines went dark, the Guardians vanished.
Barley: I believe you can bring them back.
8: Barley gives you a dusty recipe book.
Barley: My late wife's pudding. Best in the valley.
Barley: Make it for someone you love.

0: Is that a Wildling? Can I pet it?!
I'm gonna be a Warden when I grow up!
3: You're the coolest grown-up in town.
I found a shiny rock! It's mine though.
6: Can you teach me to battle?
My Nibblet likes you!
9: You're my best friend. Don't tell Nibblet.
When I'm a Warden, you can be my first challenger!

season.spring: Egg Hunt is the best day ever!
season.summer: I'm gonna catch a Ripplefin with my hands!
season.fall: Spirit's Eve is spooky! I love it!
season.winter: Snowball fights with Frostpips!

2: Pip is chasing a Nibblet.
Pip: Come back! ...It never listens to me.
Pip: How do you get Wildlings to like you? Treats? Ooh!
5: Pip shows you a drawing.
Pip: That's you and me as Wardens! I'm the tall one.
8: Pip gives you a shiny rock.
Pip: My best one. You can have it. You earned it!

0: Rare goods from far away. Fair prices. Mostly.
I come by on Fridays and Sundays.
3: You have an eye for quality.
I've traveled to seven valleys. This one's the nicest.
6: I kept something special aside for you.
Funny. I used to never stay anywhere long.
9: Maybe I'll stop traveling someday. If someone gave me a reason.
You're the reason I keep coming back.

season.spring: Spring brings rare seeds from the south.
season.summer: Summer markets are wild out east.
season.fall: Fall is when the best truffles turn up.
season.winter: Winter roads are rough. Worth it to see you.

2: Sable is polishing a strange gem.
Sable: From the far north. Want it? I'll trade for a smile.
5: Sable stares at the stars.
Sable: I never had a home. Just roads.
Sable: Hollowmere feels... different.
8: Sable hands you a worn map.
Sable: Every place I've been. Maybe I don't need any new ones.
Sable: Maybe I just need one place. And one person.

0: The museum takes donations of gems and rare items.
Your mail arrives every morning, rain or shine.
3: I found a book about Wildling breeding. Want to borrow it?
Couriersnail delivers our mail. It's slow but never late.
6: I've started a scrapbook of the valley. You're in it a lot.
Quiet mornings here are my favorite.
9: I'd rather read with you than alone.
You've filled more pages of my life than any book.

season.spring: Spring cleaning at the library. So many dusty books!
season.summer: Summer is perfect for reading under a tree.
season.fall: Fall evenings are for mystery novels.
season.winter: Winter means long nights and longer books.

2: Cora is sorting a mountain of letters.
Cora: Oh, one for you! Someone's been asking about you... Mira wants more parsnips.
5: Cora reads you a passage from an old book.
Cora: 'The Guardians sleep where the valley dreams.'
Cora: I've always wondered what it means.
8: Cora gives you a handmade bookmark.
Cora: Pressed flowers from your farm. So you'll think of me while reading.
Cora: I hope that's not too forward.

0: The forest remembers every footstep.
Prove your bond with Wildlings, and the shrine will answer.
3: The forest feels calmer since you came.
Tend your Leaf Wildlings well.
6: You walk the forest like you belong here.
The trees whisper your name now.
9: You're always welcome in Whisperwood.
The forest and I are grateful.

season.spring: The forest wakes in spring.
season.summer: Summer is loud in the forest.
season.fall: The leaves are falling. A time for rest.
season.winter: The forest sleeps. Walk quietly.

2: Ivy: The forest spirits like you. So do I.
5: Ivy: I became Warden at sixteen. It was lonely, until now.
8: Ivy: Take this. A seed from the oldest tree in Whisperwood.

0: The tides don't wait for anyone. Neither do I.
Beat me, and the shrine of Tidecove will shine again.
3: You've got sea legs, farmer.
Want to watch the sunset sometime?
6: The ocean is calmer when you're here.
I collected shells for you. Don't laugh.
9: Stay a while. The waves sound better with you here.
I think I'm falling for a farmer. Who knew?

season.spring: Spring tides are the highest.
season.summer: Summer on the beach! The best!
season.fall: Fall storms bring rare shells.
season.winter: The winter sea is beautiful and dangerous.

2: Marina: You fight with your heart. I like that.
5: Marina: My mother was Warden before me. She'd have liked you.
8: Marina: Watch the sunset with me? ...Just us.

0: Feel that heat? That's the ridge testing you.
Only the strong earn the shrine's light.
3: You don't flinch from the heat. Respect.
Ember Wildlings are loyal to the end.
6: Wanna spar? Just for fun?
You're tougher than you look.
9: You're a true friend of the ridge.
I'd walk through fire for you. Literally.

season.spring: Even in spring, the ridge is hot.
season.summer: Summer here is unbearable. I love it.
season.fall: Fall winds carry the embers far.
season.winter: Snow melts before it touches the ridge.

2: Ash: You've got fire in you.
5: Ash: I used to be afraid of fire. Now it's my strength.
8: Ash: Here. A ruby from the heart of the ridge.

0: Patience. Like stone, I don't move easily.
Show me endurance, farmer.
3: You're steady. Like bedrock.
The canyon has many secrets underground.
6: I've told you more than I've told anyone in years.
Stone remembers. So do I.
9: You're as solid as they come.
My door is always open. Well, my cave.

season.spring: Spring rains carve the canyon.
season.summer: The canyon bakes in summer.
season.fall: Fall is quiet here. Good.
season.winter: Ice cracks stone in winter. Even stone has limits.

2: Gideon: Hmph. You're not bad.
5: Gideon: I lived in the city once. Too loud. Stone is honest.
8: Gideon: An emerald. Found it the day I became Warden.

0: The wind up here can knock you flat. Hold on!
Win, and you'll fly as high as the shrine.
3: You climbed all this way again? Ha! I like you.
The wind tells me stories. Want to hear one?
6: Flying with Galecrest is like being free.
You make the heights feel less lonely.
9: Fly with me someday? I mean it.
My heart races like a gale when you're around.

season.spring: Spring winds are gentle and warm.
season.summer: Summer thermals go up for miles!
season.fall: Fall gusts are the strongest.
season.winter: Winter wind bites, but the view is worth it.

2: Kai: You've got guts climbing up here.
5: Kai: I grew up on this peak. The wind raised me.
8: Kai: I've never wanted to come down from the sky. Until you.

0: Bzzt! You're just in time for a storm!
Can you handle the charge, farmer?
3: You don't scare easy. Shocking!
I'm building a generator powered by Joltbeetles!
6: You're electric, you know that?
Want to see my latest invention?
9: You light up my world. Literally, sometimes.
Best lab partner ever.

season.spring: Spring showers are good for charging!
season.summer: Summer storms! My favorite!
season.fall: Fall is invention season.
season.winter: Static electricity in winter is the best.

2: Volta: Zap! Oops. You okay?
5: Volta: My inventions never worked until I met my Voltick.
8: Volta: Topaz! It conducts beautifully. For you.

0: ...Cold, isn't it? You'll get used to it.
The lake's shrine has been frozen for decades.
3: You came back. In this weather.
Snowpaca wool is the warmest thing in the world.
6: I don't talk much. But I like when you visit.
The ice sings at night. Listen sometime.
9: You've thawed something in me.
Stay for tea. I'll make it warm, just for you.

season.spring: The lake thaws a little in spring.
season.summer: Summer is short here. Enjoy it.
season.fall: First frost in fall. It begins.
season.winter: This is my season.

2: Nils: ...Thanks for visiting.
5: Nils: My family fished this lake for generations.
8: Nils: Wool from my Snowpaca. Make something warm.

0: Light and shadow. Both live in every heart.
The final shrine awaits those who've earned it.
3: You carry light with you, farmer.
The glade shows each visitor something different.
6: I see the stars differently since we met.
You've come so far.
9: You've brought balance back to the valley.
Twilight is my favorite time. Like you, it's in between.

season.spring: Spring twilight lasts the longest.
season.summer: Summer nights are bright here.
season.fall: Spirit's Eve is sacred in the glade.
season.winter: Winter stars are the clearest.

2: Selene: The glade likes you. That's rare.
5: Selene: I was once lost here, as a child. Hollowisp led me out.
8: Selene: A recipe for Glow Tea. It soothes the soul.
